raw_snippet: On 5 June 2026, the Group, via the Company, entered into a purchase agreement with the equity holders of Beijing XCore Sigma Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. (北京中科加禾智能科技有限公司) (“XCore Sigma”), to acquire 60% equity interests in XCore Sigma with a total cash consideration of RMB291,916,000.
value_text: agreed to acquire XCore Sigma (Beijing XCore Sigma Intelligent Technology, 中科加禾) (Inference serving)
note: Zhipu AI -> XCore Sigma (Beijing XCore Sigma Intelligent Technology, 中科加禾) (AI infrastructure software for heterogeneous chips (compiler, runtime, inference engine)); sublayer inference_serving; acquisition; a 60% controlling stake; first confirmed in Zhipu's interim results of 31 Aug 2026, which date the agreement 5 Jun 2026. Ledger sweep of 23 Sep 2026.
